comments.comment: 1:07:16 If he keeps just one thing, it should be the knife, not the computer. His type of "minimalism" assumes that others will store the items and food he needs to survive. Good documentary, but there's something that drives me nuts about many minimalists. When they break their leg in the mountains, they rely on other people to save them. I have extra water and food at home in case of an earthquake, and I carry extra warm clothes plus first aid supplies in the wilderness because I sometimes need to bail out guys like this. Many urban minimalists are short sighted and have normalcy bias. Unless they have truly gone back to the land, they are still relying on the material world by expecting other people to have what they need in times of emergency.   A true minimalist has the skills to live directly off the land.  The urban minimalist is relying on modern infrastructure and the expectation that other people have what he needs. So long as humanity is ill-equipped for life in the wild, some of us need to be stashing supplies for emergency scenarios. We don't all get to become urban minimalists. Someone needs to grow and store the food for this guy to eat.
